app.name: Scan-to-Drive
app.tagline: Company car trips, logged with a scan.

home.title: Every company trip, logged with one scan
home.lead: Drivers scan the car, passengers confirm with their ID, and the transport office sees every trip live.
home.driverHint: Sign in with your employee ID and PIN
home.passengerNote: Passenger? Scan the QR code the driver shows you. No sign-in needed.

placeholder.title: This screen is being built
placeholder.body: It arrives in step {step} of the frontend build.

overtime.title: Driver overtime
overtime.lead: Overtime will be worked out from the trips drivers already log, so nobody has to fill in a separate sheet.
overtime.point1Body: Each driver's trip times compared with their working hours, day by day.
overtime.point2Body: Totals for the month, with the trips behind every hour.
overtime.point3Body: Approve overtime and export it to Excel for HR and accounts.
overtime.note: Tell us your shift rules (start time, end time, weekends, holidays) and we will plan this with you.

dashboard.skeletonNote: Live numbers arrive in step 5. This is the layout.

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.lead: Every shared piece of the interface in one place. Only shown while developing.

driverAuth.signInLead: Use your employee ID and 4-digit PIN. This phone keeps you signed in for 30 days.
driverAuth.firstTimeHint: First time? Type any 4 digits. You will choose your own PIN on the next screen.
driverAuth.choosePinLead: Pick 4 digits you will remember. Easy ones like 1111 or 1234 are not allowed.
driverAuth.confirmPinLead: Just to be sure it is right.
driverAuth.forgotPin: Forgot your PIN? Ask the transport office to reset it.
driverAuth.errWrong: Employee ID or PIN is not correct.
driverAuth.errLocked: Too many wrong tries. Wait 15 minutes or ask the transport office.
driverAuth.errWeak: This PIN is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
driverAuth.errMismatch: The two PINs are different. Try again.
driverAuth.errAlreadySet: Your PIN is already set. Sign in with it, or ask the transport office to reset it.
driverAuth.errNetwork: No connection. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
driverAuth.errServer: Something went wrong. Please try again.

driverHome.scanTitle: Scan the QR sticker in the car
driverHome.scanBody: Open your phone camera and point it at the sticker in the car. The car page opens by itself.
driverHome.typeCode: No sticker? Type the car code
driverHome.offlineBody: Check that the backend is running, then reload this page.

carPage.title: Car {code}
carPage.body: The car page with the start form arrives in step 3 of the build.
